card.name: Spelled-out numbers at sentence start
card.fires_on: Spelled-out number words such as Eight-y, Twenty, Thirty, thousand or hundred, usually opening a sentence or clause. It is strongest on the 'y' of Eighty before '-three' or 'percent'.

modes.label: Eighty at sentence start
modes.description: The 'y' ending of Eighty opening a sentence about a percentage of patients.
modes.example: Eight<<y>>-three percent of patients required initiation of lipid

modes.label: Twenty or Thirty before a time unit
modes.description: A tens word starting a sentence and followed by minutes or hours.
modes.example: .<< Thirty>> minutes after Technescan PYP injection

modes.label: Thousand or hundred in long numbers
modes.description: The scale word inside a spelled-out larger number.
modes.example: Two<< thousand>> three hundred and twenty one women from the

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward continuing a spelled-out number, such as a hyphenated unit or a following number word.
card.plain: It lights up on numbers written out in words, like Eighty or Thirty, at the start of a sentence.
